primary_gt.interpretation: The Central Park one-hour intensity is large enough relative to event-scale gridded maxima to anchor the NYC diagnosis in a local hourly burst, while the broader maxima provide scale context.

criteria.name: Requested JSON answer
criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON with the local hourly value, regional lower bound, regional ratio, all three gridded entries, final label, and one-sentence interpretation.
criteria.partial_credit: Minor field-name or nesting differences are acceptable when every required value and conclusion is present.

criteria.name: Central Park hourly conversion
criteria.description: Computes 3.47 inches as 88.138 mm and reports the one-hour intensity as 88.138 mm/h for September 1, 2021.
criteria.partial_credit: Credit is reduced for coarse rounding, missing units, or omitting the one-hour intensity statement.

criteria.name: Regional lower-bound ratio
criteria.description: Computes 10 inches as 254.0 mm and the Central Park-hour to regional lower-bound ratio as 0.347.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit is earned for one correct value or a correct setup with a small arithmetic error.

criteria.name: Gridded max-to-mean ratios
criteria.description: Computes ERA5-Land, GPM IMERG, and CHIRPS max-to-mean ratios as 2.519, 2.574, and 2.065 within tolerance.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit is earned when two sources are correct or all sources are attempted with small calculation errors.

criteria.name: Local-hour to grid-maximum ratios
criteria.description: Computes Central Park-hour to grid-maximum ratios as 0.693, 0.644, and 0.754 for ERA5-Land, GPM IMERG, and CHIRPS.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit is earned when two ratios are correct or all three are directionally correct but outside tolerance.

criteria.name: Computed final interpretation
criteria.description: Identifies the final label as short_duration_urban_rainfall_burst or an equivalent concise label tied to the conversions and scale ratios.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit is earned for a directionally correct label that is too wordy or insufficiently tied to the computed values.

event.event_name: Post-Tropical Cyclone Ida NYC flash flood
